messages.Nisipul se strânge pe liniile nodale, un: Sand collects along nodal lines, where the disk does not vibrate. Increase the driving frequency and observe nodal diameters and circles.
messages.Modurile neexcitate în punctul ales sunt: Modes not excited at the selected point are disabled.
messages.Atinge sau trage pe disc pentru a muta e: Touch or drag on the disk to move the exciter. With the disk focused, you can also use the arrow keys.
messages.Diametru: {d} cm; grosime: {h} mm; rigid: Diameter: {d} cm; thickness: {h} mm; rigidity D = {D} N·m; factor K = {K} Hz; ν = 0.33.
messages.Frecvența depășește banda audio a demons: The frequency is above the demonstration audio band; the tone is muted.
messages.Tonul are frecvența generatorului. Volum: The tone follows the driving frequency. Audio volume is separate from vibration amplitude.
messages.Rezonanță apropiată: {n} diametre nodale: Nearby resonance: {n} nodal diameters, {s} nodal circles.
messages.Între rezonanțe: vibrație redusă; figura: Between resonances: weak vibration; the previous pattern may persist.
messages.La rezonanță, discul are regiuni care vi: At resonance the disk has strongly vibrating regions and nodal lines where transverse displacement is zero. Grains are agitated in vibrating regions and collect near nodes. The figure shows the spatial distribution of vibration, rather than an image of the instantaneous disk displacement.
messages.Un mod (n, s) are n diametre nodale și s: A mode (n, s) has n nodal diameters and s nodal circles. Modes with n = 0 are axisymmetric. The two independent orientations of a mode with n > 0 have the same frequency for an ideal disk; the exciter position selects the combination and visible orientation.
messages.În centru, modurile cu n > 0 au deplasar: At the center, modes with n > 0 have zero displacement and are not excited by an ideal point force. Move the white marker on the disk to activate other families. An exciter placed on a mode node cannot efficiently excite that mode.
messages.E este modulul Young, ρ densitatea, h gr: E is Young’s modulus, ρ the density, h the thickness, a the radius and D the bending rigidity. λ² is a dimensionless parameter determined by the modal family and boundary conditions.
messages.Modelul descrie un disc subțire, omogen,: The model describes a thin, uniform, isotropic disk with a free edge and ν = 0.33. This value is a shared assumption for the three demonstration materials. The exciter applies a force without rigidly clamping the center. A bolted or clamped disk has different frequencies and boundary conditions.
messages.La același material și aceeași rază, dub: For the same material and radius, doubling thickness doubles the frequencies.
messages.La același material și aceeași grosime,: For the same material and thickness, doubling radius reduces the frequencies by a factor of four.
messages.Influența materialului este dată de √(E/: The material effect scales as √(E/ρ), for the same geometry and Poisson ratio.
messages.Amplitudinea generatorului și cantitatea: Driving amplitude and sand count change the visualization without changing natural frequencies in this linear model.
messages.Alege o rezonanță cu excitație în centru: Choose a resonance with central excitation. Count the nodal circles and compare the figure with indices (n, s).
messages.Mută excitatorul prin atingere sau trage: Move the exciter using touch or dragging. Choose a mode with nodal diameters and observe its orientation. With the disk focused, you can also move the exciter using arrow keys.
messages.Oprește animația, schimbă raza sau grosi: Pause the animation, change radius or thickness and compare the listed frequencies. Parameters can also be changed while paused.
Use a slow frequency sweep. Stop near resonance and let the sand settle. Scatter sand restores the initial distribution.
messages.Ce moduri sunt excitate în centru?: Which modes are excited at the center?
messages.Numai familiile cu n = 0, pentru o forță: Only families with n = 0, for an ideal point force at the center. Families with nodal diameters are not excited at this point.
messages.Ce se întâmplă dacă raza crește de la 10: What happens if radius increases from 10 cm to 15 cm?
messages.Frecvența aceluiași mod se înmulțește cu: The frequency of the same mode is multiplied by (10/15)² = 4/9, for unchanged material and thickness.
messages.Mai mult nisip înseamnă altă frecvență?: Does more sand mean a different frequency?
messages.Nu în această demonstrație: nisipul este: Not in this demonstration: sand is a tracer without dynamic mass. In a real experiment, sand mass and contacts can affect vibration.
messages.De ce poate rămâne figura după schimbare: Why can the figure remain after changing frequency?
messages.La vibrație slabă, granulele pot rămâne: With weak vibration the grains may remain almost still. Press Scatter sand to start a new observation.
messages.Sunt incluse 19 familii modale, cu răspu: The model includes 19 modal families, complex harmonic responses and quality factor Q = 45. Rigid translation and tilt modes at zero frequency do not produce the bending patterns studied here. Sand motion is a stochastic teaching approximation, rather than a full calculation of collisions and friction.
messages.Sunetul este un ton sinusoidal la frecve: Sound is a sinusoidal tone at the driving frequency, available from 20 to 18,000 Hz; it does not reproduce the timbre of a real metal disk. Mechanical frequencies outside this band remain available in the laboratory.
messages.K. Itao și S. H. Crandall — Natural Mode: K. Itao and S. H. Crandall — Natural Modes and Natural Frequencies of Uniform, Circular, Free-Edge Plates
messages.Frecvența este în afara benzii audio a d: The frequency is outside the demonstration audio band; the tone is muted.
messages.Figura punctată arată nodurile modului a: The dashed figure shows the selected mode’s nodes. Sand gradually collects nearby.
messages.Alege o rezonanță pentru a vedea figura: Choose a resonance to see its nodal figure.
messages.Figura punctată arată nodurile modului a: The dashed figure shows the selected mode’s nodes. Excitation is weak here; move the exciter or increase amplitude.
messages.De unde vine numele „Figuri Chladni”?: Where does the name “Chladni figures” come from?
messages.Aceste figuri poartă numele fizicianului: These figures are named after the physicist and musician Ernst Florens Friedrich Chladni. In 1787 he published experiments in which he sprinkled sand on plates and made them vibrate with a violin bow. Different tones produced different patterns as sand collected along nodal lines. “Chladni” identifies the researcher who made these figures widely known, rather than a particular geometric shape.
messages.Indicii (n, s) descriu geometria fiecăru: The indices (n, s) describe each mode’s geometry: n is the number of nodal diameters and s the number of nodal circles.
messages.Sursă istorică: Universitatea din Geneva: Historical source: University of Geneva — Voir le son
